prompts.welcome: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: transparent PNG mascot for a premium WorkBuddy software product keynote. Reference image is supplied for CHARACTER IDENTITY ONLY: preserve the same friendly silver-white chibi cat-eared robot, broad rounded black screen face, two vertical glowing jade-green eyes, black ear interiors, circular headphone-like silver/black side modules, compact rounded silver body, short articulated limbs and tiny curved cat tail. Keep its recognizable silhouette and proportions very close to the reference. Premium polished 3D product render, satin silver with controlled specular highlights, no purple/blue, green accents #28B894. Full body, centered, clean generous margin, high resolution. GENUINELY TRANSPARENT ALPHA BACKGROUND, no checkerboard painted into background, no room, no floor or horizon, no frame, no text, no watermark, no brand lettering. Clear single character only. Studio lighting works on both dark green and warm white backgrounds. Pose: standing in an energetic gentle step forward, facing viewer at three-quarter angle, one arm raised with an open palm waving hello, other hand resting at hip, friendly confident expression with two jade green vertical pill eyes. A warm product host welcoming attendees. No props.
